card.name: Inside names of institutes and organizations
card.fires_on: A word inside the proper name of an institute, foundation, commission or project, often right after 'the' or 'Institute of'. Common words are Taiwan, of, Science, American and Canada.

modes.label: Other name parts
modes.description: A country or field word that starts or continues a national organization name.
modes.example: funded by the<< Canada>> Foundation for Innovation; the University of Toronto
